messages:
ollie: uploaded 3 photos — meet Marshmallow, the bathtub capybara. He approves of bubble time 🛁 :capybara: https://img.redwood.internal/ollie/marshmallow-1.jpg https://img.redwood.internal/ollie/marshmallow-2.jpg https://img.redwood.internal/ollie/marshmallow-3.jpg

maria: wait. is that... a capybara??!! :exploding_head:

devin: absolute unit. how long have you had him?

ollie: rescued from a small-animal foster program last month. turns out capybaras love warm baths and eucalyptus-scented towels (who knew). he thinks the bathtub is a hot tub.

sanjay: can we adopt him as the official office mascot for offsite 2026? asking for team morale. :raised_hands:

maria: we should 100% have a Marshmallow cameo on stage during intros. bring a tiny floaty.

devin: logistics question — is it legal to travel with a capybara across state lines? asking for someone who definitely might bring one to the next hackathon. :eyes:

ollie: short answer: lots of paperwork, long answer: yep, with the right permits and a very calm carrier. also he loves snacks (plantain chips are a hit).

giphy-bot: https://giphy.com/gifs/capybara-chill-3o6Mbm2Z0uK6rx1sVq — *gif posted*

maria: this thread cured my afternoon slump. thanks, Marshmallow. :heart_eyes: :sparkles:

ollie: posting one more — him judging my spreadsheet skills. caption suggestions welcome. :laughing: https://img.redwood.internal/ollie/marshmallow-judgy.jpg

sanjay: "v1.0 helm chart: 100% more floaty" :tada:

devin: "when you forget to set the timeout and the convo runs all night" :rofl:

ollie: will create a merch vote: plush vs sticker. thoughts?
